error.title: something went wrong

settings.tokenPlaceholder: Paste to set or replace - stored in the OS keychain
settings.patScopes: Classic token: repo, read:org, read:user - read:user is the one the contribution heatmap needs for private activity.
settings.patFineGrained: Fine-grained token: set the resource owner to the org, then grant Metadata, Pull requests, Issues, and Contents as read-only. It has no equivalent of read:user, so the heatmap stays public-only.
settings.orgsPlaceholder: acme-inc, author:your-login for your own PRs anywhere
settings.deviceInstructions: We opened GitHub in your browser. Enter this code there to finish:
settings.deviceWaiting: Waiting for you to approve in the browser...
settings.noGithubAccounts: No accounts yet. Add one to start tracking PRs.
settings.devModeCountdown: {n} more taps to toggle developer mode
settings.devModeActive: Developer mode is on - crash screens show technical details.
